about: Computer Engineering graduate with experience in application development and system testing. I have worked with System Analysts and team members to develop business applications, and I have experience preparing system documents, UAT documents, and test cases.

I work with SQL Server, C#, ASP.NET Core, and APIs, including integration with SAP APIs, and I can investigate and fix application problems by myself. I am interested in Business Analyst and System Analyst roles.

Prepare Functional Specifications, UAT documents, Business Simulation (BizSim), and Test Cases.
Test applications to make sure they work correctly, and investigate and fix application problems.
Develop APIs and connect applications with SAP APIs.
Check quality documents and update related information.
Work with team members on daily operations.
Worked with other interns to develop an internal task management system.
Helped collect requirements, design screens, and develop the application.
